author: Business Insider
description:
Sondre Pettersen lives in one of the most expensive places in the world. At 25,  he works as a cybersecurity incident response analyst in Oslo, Norway, earning about  $78,000 a year. He recently purchased a $465,000 apartment and carefully manages his expenses, saving around $1,000 a month while prioritizing travel, skiing, and other hobbies.

In this episode of "The Pay Check," Sondre breaks down his cost of living, sharing exactly how he earns, spends, budgets.

Watch our complete collection of The Pay Check videos: https://bit.ly/4f8lMhh 

Do you want to be featured in an upcoming episode of Business Insider's The Pay Check? We're looking for people who are open to sharing what they earn, spend, and what everyday life costs where they live. 

If you'd like to nominate yourself, enter your details in the form below and our team may be in touch:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf6etbN1DdddaWV6Hql6rSkakYIAh7P04SbMSSFsK3QwZxSbA/viewform

For more: https://www.instagram.com/son
